questions.question: Explain how an undergravel filter works. Why is it considered less effective in modern aquariums? / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain how an undergravel filter works. Why is it considered less effective in
  • modern aquariums? [U] / [CO1]
  • An undergravel filter (UGF) is a biological filtration system placed beneath the
  • aquarium substrate (gravel). Uplift tubes, Air pumps or powerheads , suction, pulling
  • water down through the gravel , beneficial bacteria colonize the substrate ,
  • Nitrosomonas, Nitrobacter These bacteria convert toxic ammonia → nitrite → nitrate
  • (biological filtration), Filtered water then rises up through the uplift tubes
  • Less effective in modern aquariums : Accumulation of waste , Difficult maintenance,
  • Limited filtration efficiency , Not suitable for pla nted tanks , Inflexibility, Better
  • alternatives available (canister filter etc.)
